target.description: Measured liquid-droplet diameter of a free-floating methanol droplet at times after the cutoff, as an unconditional predictive distribution (still burning, or extinguished earlier), plus the cumulative incidence of the end of the hot-flame phase and of disruption.
excludes: flame temperature, soot, species or radiant emission
fuels other than methanol and fibre-supported droplets
a calibrated posterior: the spread is an assumed scenario distribution

features.name: c_logd0
features.transform: ln(sqrt(q0) / norm.d_ref_m); q0 = mean(D^2) over the head window advanced to t = 0 with the population rate at w = 0 @1

features.name: w
features.transform: clamp(1 - D^2 / q0, 0, 1), integrated by the forward @1

features.name: s
features.transform: t * norm.k_ref_m2_s / q0 with t in seconds since the time origin (a diffusion clock:                  the same s is the same fraction of a D0^2 / K_ref lifetime for every droplet) @1

features.name: e_late
features.transform: clamp(ln(max(K_obs, enc.k_floor_m2_s) / K_model), +-enc.e_clip); K_obs = finite difference of window means of D^2 (mid -> tail); K_model = harmonic Simpson mean of the population rate over the same progress interval @1

features.name: e_early
features.transform: as e_late for head -> mid; both equal the head -> tail value when the mid window is empty @1

features.name: g_span
features.transform: ln((mean time of tail window - mean time of head window) / 1 s) @1

tensors.name: rate.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the rate network; row j reads x = (c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp, c_logd0, w, s).

tensors.name: rate.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the rate network (hinge positions).

tensors.name: rate.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the rate network (slope changes at the hinges).

tensors.name: rate.skip
tensors.description: Linear law of ln(K/K_ref) in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: rate.b0
tensors.description: ln(K/K_ref) at the reference state x = 0: air, 1e5 Pa, D0 = 2 mm, w = 0, s = 0, before hinge terms.

tensors.name: haz.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the extinction network; same input x as the rate network.

tensors.name: haz.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the extinction network.

tensors.name: haz.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the extinction network.

tensors.name: haz.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of ln(eta) in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: haz.b0
tensors.description: ln(eta) at x = 0 before hinge terms.

tensors.name: haz.link_b
tensors.description: Coupling of the run's log-rate offset b into ln(eta).

tensors.name: haz.log_disruption
tensors.description: ln of the constant disruption hazard.

tensors.name: enc.gain_w
tensors.description: Weights of the gain logit on (g_span, g_count, g_progress).

tensors.name: enc.gain_b
tensors.description: Bias of the gain logit; gain = sigmoid(logit).

tensors.name: enc.mix
tensors.description: Weights of (e_late, e_early) in the run's log-rate innovation.

tensors.name: unc.s_pop
tensors.description: Assumed sd of a run's ln K around the population law before any prefix evidence.

tensors.name: unc.s_floor
tensors.description: Assumed sd of ln K that no prefix removes.

tensors.name: unc.sigma_d
tensors.description: Assumed sd of one diameter measurement.

tensors.name: post.k_evap
tensors.description: d(D^2)/dt magnitude of the extinguished droplet.

tensors.name: norm.d_ref_m
tensors.description: Reference diameter of c_logd0.

tensors.name: norm.p_ref_pa
tensors.description: Reference pressure of c_logp.

tensors.name: norm.k_ref_m2_s
tensors.description: Reference burning-rate constant.

tensors.name: norm.n_ref
tensors.description: Reference number of prefix points of g_count.

tensors.name: enc.window_frac
tensors.description: Head, mid and tail windows each span this fraction of the prefix duration.

tensors.name: enc.e_clip
tensors.description: Clamp of the log-rate innovations.

tensors.name: enc.k_floor_m2_s
tensors.description: Floor of an observed rate before its logarithm.

tensors.name: enc.w_ref
tensors.description: Progress at which g_progress saturates.

tensors.name: enc.min_points
tensors.description: Fewest valid prefix diameters for a forecast.

tensors.name: haz.log_eta_cap
tensors.description: Upper clamp of ln(eta) (numerical safety).

tensors.name: num.dt_s
tensors.description: Largest RK4 step; steps end exactly on forecast times.

tensors.name: num.d_min_m
tensors.description: Support floor: the model stops at this diameter.

tensors.name: num.t_valid_s
tensors.description: Model horizon since the time origin.

tensors.name: num.z_step
tensors.description: Spacing of the scenario nodes of z.

tensors.name: num.z_count
tensors.description: Number of scenario nodes of z, centred on 0.

notes: Prefix observations: liquid_diameter, valid, positive, 0 <= t <= cutoff, first of equal time stamps. State at the cutoff: tail-window mean of D^2 carried to the cutoff along the observed mid -> tail finite difference (no weight enters it). Scenario nodes z_k = (k - (n-1)/2) * z_step with weights proportional to exp(-z^2/2). Predictive quantiles: weighted quantiles of the mixture atoms (burning per scenario; extinguished per scenario and RK4 step), widened around the median by unc.sigma_d in quadrature. Uncertainty kind: assumed_noise.
